title: Change explanation schema
responsibility: Defines the scratch location, attempt outcomes and validated explanation of a particular unit change.

outputs.name: explanationsFile
outputs.description: Scratch NDJSON path .cache/harness/explanations.ndjson, outside the source tree.

outputs.name: explanationOutcomes
outputs.description: Allowed attempt outcomes: improved, not-improved and not-applicable.

outputs.name: explanationSchema
outputs.description: Strict Zod schema naming the unit, symbol, optional file, added/modified/removed change, nullable before/after fingerprints, behavior, simplification and performance attempts, and recording time. Text is trimmed and nonempty.
